title: ChatEnvelope
description: The only shape platform input takes after an adapter (CONTRACTS §4, SEC-GW-1). Text fields are SafeText: NFKC-normalized, control/bidi/zero-width stripped by the gateway (§3.5); the schema enforces length only.

display_name.description: Identity only; never rendered or put in prompts.

text.description: Over 300 after normalization is rejected, never truncated (Q-CT-1).

received_at.description: Gateway wall clock, RFC 3339 UTC; never used by the sim.

account_created_at.description: null when the platform does not provide it; never guessed.
